First test build of Ionium, Celeritas running on Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge.

This is a pre-release. It works in our testing, but it's had very little playtime so far. Expect bugs and keep a backup of your worlds.

**You can't just drop this into a normal Forge 1.8.9 install.** It needs Java 21, RetroFuturaBootstrap (we use [8to25](https://github.com/Oondanomala/8to25)) and LWJGL 3 from the launcher, plus ION Client for the LWJGL 2 compatibility layer. A ready-made Prism Launcher instance is coming. Until then this build is mainly for people who want to help test.

What we've seen so far, render distance 12, Forge on Java 21: about 710 → 990 fps standing still and 520 → 980 fps when turning the camera. Lots of mobs on screen barely changes anything. OptiFine is still faster on Forge at the moment, and the two don't work together.

Known issues:
- Ionium doesn't show up in Forge's mod list yet. Check F3, it says "Ionium Renderer" on the right.
- The game once hung while saving on exit. We haven't been able to reproduce it since.

Based on Celeritas by embeddedt (LGPL-3.0). Not affiliated with CaffeineMC or the Celeritas project, so please report problems here.
